scope: bookkeeping oracle of a diagnostic coupling bench: energy and an equivalent oxygen debit; no fuel mass, no species, no temperatures, not the combustion of the furniture

numerical_tolerance.basis: rounding of double precision; the same as the isolated owner

oxygen.what_it_is: equivalent demand prescribed by the bench: accepted energy times the constant the engine sink already uses; not a stoichiometry validated for this chair and not a reconstruction of the oxygen measured in the duct

radiative_fractions.what: engine default, also the CFAST default
published value minus its expanded uncertainty
published value plus its expanded uncertainty

radiative_fraction_is: a datum of the case, never of the source; none is a fraction measured in an enclosure

peak_and_step.rule: the power of a step is the energy of its interval over the whole step
peak_and_step.consequence: its maximum over a run depends on the step and is not the instantaneous peak

synthetic_triangle.why: a step returns the mean of its interval: with slopes of 10 kW/s the best step is the peak minus 5 dt when the peak falls on a step end and minus 2.5 dt when it falls in the middle of a step; the energy is the same for every step
